title: Parity-Reduced Transverse Wronskians, Jensen-Laguerre Moment Identities, and Division-Free Interval Enclosures for Riemann's Xi-Function
proven_theorems: Canonical parity-reduced Wigner-hyperbolic representation W_tilde(d,t) = W(d,t)/d = 32 int_0^infty y^2 sinc_hyp(2dy) I(y,t) dy with classical Laguerre boundary value W_tilde(0,t) = L_1(Xi;t) = (Xi'(t))^2 - Xi(t)Xi''(t) (Proposition 2.1)

Jensen (1913) and Csordas-Varga (1990) moment identity c_{2m-1}(t) = m L_m(Xi;t) = (2^{2m+3}/(2m-1)!) int_0^infty y^{2m} I(y,t) dy and local multiplicity jet c_{2m-1}(t_0) = (m/(m!)^2)(Xi^{(m)}(t_0))^2 (Theorem 3.1)
Division-free Cauchy-Riemann gradients and positive-weight integral representations of sinc_hyp(w) and eta_hyp(w) yielding non-harmonic-safe Taylor majorants (Propositions 3.2 & 4.1)

Methodological mpmath.iv enclosures on t <= 55 (c_1,c_3,c_5 > 0 at gamma_1..gamma_10, 80 collar boxes around gamma_k and true Xi'-extrema tau_k, 5 Cauchy rectangles) and Higham |x|^T|y| roundoff-amplification proof for IEEE-754 float64 quadrature (Theorem 1.1 & Section 5.3)
